warnings: Chords on every truss are C-100x50x20x1.6 (the callout has leaders to the top chord, the bottom chord and a vertical); the diagonals are C-75x45x15x1.6. On T3 the C-75x45x15x1.6 callout also leads to a vertical. The second section is kept as web_steel_section (key already used for this case in this batch, houses 118/120).

The elevations print no grid bubbles; supports were matched to the S-03 plan from the posts drawn on them and the T-marks on T3 (see the grid master warnings). Panel chains are recorded in the grid master dimension_chains[] and their ticks are y/x dummies.

T1/T2 print 0.785 (อะเส line to ridge) and 0.345 (เสริมรับจันทัน line to อะเส line) on their left; T3 prints 0.677 (depth). height_mm = the truss depth as printed (0.785 for T1/T2, 0.677 for T3). รูปตัด A/B print 0.68 from +3.20 to the ridge +3.88 — not reconciled with 0.785.
อะเส 2C-100x50x20x2.3 (+3.20) and เสริมรับจันทัน C-100x50x20x2.3 (+2.80) are called out on T1/T2 — those members are recorded on the S-03 roof_frame_plan file.
